(A) The reduction of Al2O3 with coke (C) at a temperature > 2500C is not carried out due to the formation of carbides.

(B) It is correct as neutralisation of aluminate solution is done by passing CO2 gas to precipitate hydrated alumina.

(C) Reaction of powdered one is carried out with hot concentrated NaOH at 473 K - 523 K and 35 - 36 bar pressure.

(D) Electrolysis of Al2O3 is done mixed with Na3AlF6 to produce Al and CO2. It is a correct statement.

NO is paramagnetic due to the presence of unpaired electron. It is a neutral oxide. It is colourless.

NO अयुग्मित इलेक्ट्रॉन की उपस्थिति के कारण अनुचुंबकीय है। यह एक उदासीन ऑक्साइड है। यह रंगहीन है।

अतः, (A) और (D) सही कथन हैं।
